description:
[Admin] List the company's media library: images, MP4 video, audio and WOFF2 fonts, newest first. A file's `url` is what page blocks, brand logos and font settings take. Filter by `folder` ("" is the top). include_folders=true adds every folder (empty ones included) with how many files each holds; a folder name is the `folder` value here, in start_media_upload and in manage_media_file. A sub-company also sees its parent's files, marked read_only: usable, not changeable.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

folder.description: Only files in this library folder.

include_folders.description: Also return `folders`: the company's library folders with how many files each holds (what manage_media_folder lists). Default false.

include_parent.description: Also list the parent company's files, read only, when this company is a sub-company. Default true.

kind.description: Only files of this kind: image, video, audio or font.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

search.description: Only files whose name contains this text.

name: list_media_files
title: List media library files
